text:
Marta: Reproduced another tail spike when compaction and eviction interleave on dense tiny-alloc workloads. Short repro in perf harness.

Devon: Minimal sequence?

Marta: alloc storm of 2-6KB tensors -> slab becomes fragmented; compaction starts and grabs slab lock; eviction runs and promotes pages; compactor retries and holds lock longer -> allocator stalls.

Hui: Two fixes: (A) make compaction incremental/yielding with a cursor, (B) make eviction compaction-aware and avoid overlapping work.

Devon: I prefer (A) first. Add compact_step(cursor, budget_bytes) that returns new cursor and yielded flag. Keep cursor small (8 bytes).

Marta: Agree. For (B) we can add a transient residency hint "compaction_epoch" so eviction scoring deprioritizes pages. If retries exceed N, fallback to safe demote.

Hui: Telemetry: add compact_yields, compaction_cursor_staleness, eviction_overlap_count. They'll help tune budgets.

Devon: Rollout plan: feature-flag cooperative_compact on a single pool. infra-bot can create canary.

ops-bot: Canary created -> id=canary-1738889995 target=pool-beta config={"cooperative_compact":true,"compaction_hint_ttl":90} 

Marta: I'll prototype cursor layout and compact_step loop. Devon will wire eviction hint usage. Hui will add telemetry.

Devon: I'll aim for a small PR with compact_step skeleton by EOD Thu. Keep cursor opaque initially.

Hui: Perf test: synthetic microbatch generator + forced offload GC. Measure p99 latency, compact_yields, and CPU delta. If p99 improves and CPU cost acceptable, expand.

Marta: Good. If canary regresses we'll flip the flag and collect traces.

Devon: :+1:

Hui: :rocket:
